hero_title: Turning technical ideas into things that work.
hero_text: AFT brings engineering, electronics, digital manufacturing and software development together to build practical solutions — from an initial idea to a working prototype.
about_title: We do not just use technology. We want to understand it and build it.
about_text: AFT is a multidisciplinary technology initiative connecting manufacturing, electronic engineering, smart systems and software. The goal is to develop solutions that can be tested and improved, with attention to cost, manufacturability and maintenance.
domains_intro: We connect disciplines to create integrated solutions instead of treating every component in isolation.
domain_1_text: Product modeling, additive manufacturing, prototypes and production-ready files.
domain_2_text: Circuit design, PCB layouts, assembly, soldering, testing and fault diagnosis.
domain_3_text: Control systems, microcontrollers, sensors, robotics and Internet of Things applications.
domain_4_text: Websites, applications, software tools and applied AI experiments.
domain_5_text: Battery and charging solutions, solar energy, power management and smart control.
domain_6_text: Laser engraving and cutting, product design, and custom parts and materials.
process_title: How does an idea become a solution?
step_1_text: Define the need, constraints and expected outcome before choosing a technology.
step_2_text: Translate the idea into a design, components and an executable plan.
step_3_text: Build a prototype, measure performance and identify weaknesses.
step_4_text: Refine the solution, document findings and prepare the next iteration.
projects_note: Published work will be added progressively.
projects_title: From the lab to the real world
projects_intro: Only documented work belongs here, with its status and development stages clearly identified.
project_empty_title: The project gallery is being prepared
project_empty_text: Projects will be published after documenting their images, components and test results. Concept placeholders will not be presented as completed work.
lab_text: AFT Lab is a space for research, experimentation and prototyping. We document what works and what needs redesign, because real progress depends on testing rather than claims.
contact_title: Have an idea or a technical challenge? Start with the problem.
contact_text: Get in touch to discuss a project idea, a technical question or a potential collaboration.
footer_note: Built with curiosity. Designed for progress.
